SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssimListMapper.getTotalCount : 전체게시글수 */ COUNT(*) FROM AYE100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시판유형구분코드 */ AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )

AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%' /* 작성자 조회 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssimListMapper.selectBbssoldList : 본인상담게시판 */ AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글 고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글 제목명 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ , CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분명 */ , DECODE(DD.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, NULL, '', 'Y') AS SRVY_RESULT_YN /* 설문조사여부 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT
, ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(A1.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT) FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원명 */ , ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS CONSTT_ID /*상담원아이디*/ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS REPLY_CNT /* 댓글수 */ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제상태대분류구분코드 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제원인대분류구분코드 , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD) AS GUBUN
, AA.EML_SNDNG_CYCL_DAYCNT AS EML_SNDNG_CYCL_DAYCNT , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.EML_SNDNG_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-') AS EML_SNDNG_YMD , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.SNDNG_PRNMNT_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-') AS SNDNG_PRNMNT_YMD
FROM AYE100 AA , SAC100 CC
, ( SELECT A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD FROM AYE195 A , AYE196 B WHERE A.INDEX_SN = B.INDEX_SN AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} GROUP BY A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) DD
, ( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD FROM AYE260 WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' GROUP BY BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) DD
, SAC100 EE WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND AA.END_YN = 'Y'
AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글유형구분코드 */
AND CC.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 위기유형구분코드 */ AND CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) = AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD AND DD.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO (+) = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND DD.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD (+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND EE.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ AND EE.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 위기유형구분 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
/* 작성자 조회 */ AND CASE WHEN LENGTH(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) < 20 THEN AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT ELSE C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) END LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'Y' FROM AYA150 ZZ WHERE AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = ZZ.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = ZZ.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND ZZ.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C##RG.DEC_B64(ZZ.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{CONSTT_NM_ENCPT} || '%' --상담자명 )
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD IS NULL /* 문제상태미등록 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
AND AA.EML_SNDNG_CYCL_DAYCNT IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

'), '//', '
')) AS ANS_CN /* 질의응답 */ , (SELECT Y.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM AYE210 X ,SAC100 Y WHERE Y.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD' AND Y.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = X.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD AND X.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND X.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' --03:이음e AND ROWNUM =1) AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD /* 이음-e 종류명 */ , (SELECT X.SESN_MNG_NO FROM AYE210 X WHERE X.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND X.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' --03:이음e AND ROWNUM =1) AS SESN_MNG_NO /* 이음-e 회기 */ , ( SELECT B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM || ' - ' ||A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM NM FROM SAC100 A , SAC100 B , AYE100 C WHERE A.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRL_INSP_MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 IS NOT NULL AND B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRL_INSP_LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD' AND A.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE = B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND C.TRL_INSP_SN = A.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 AND C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND C.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' ) AS TRL_INSP_THMA /* 심리검사주제 */ , REPLACE(AA.TRL_INSP_DTL_CN, '|', '
') AS TRL_INSP_DTL_CN /* 심리검사내용 */ , ( SELECT A.TTL_NM || ' - ' || B.TTL_NM FROM AYE400 A , AYE410 B WHERE 1=1 AND B.GRIEF_SLTN_ALKIOL_SN = AA.GRIEF_SLTN_ALKIOL_SN AND A.GRIEF_SLTN_ALKIOL_THMA_SN = B.GRIEF_SLTN_ALKIOL_THMA_SN ) AS GRIEF_SLTN_ALKIOL_NM /* 고민해결백과 명 */ , AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /* 게시글내용 */ , ( SELECT INDEX_SN FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS INDEX_SN /* 상담자일련번호 */ , ( SELECT REG_DT FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS REG_DT /* 상담자배정일자 */ , ( SELECT CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS CONSTT_ID /* 상담자아이디 */ , ( SELECT A1.MEMO_NM FROM AYA160 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS , AA.REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD AS REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD /* 실제상담자구분코드 */ , AA.REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN AS REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN /* 실제상담자기타내용 */ , AA.YNGBGS_SE_NO AS YNGBGS_SE_NO /* 청소년구분번호 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태대분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD /* 문제상태중분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태소분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인대분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인소분류구분코드 */ , AA.ETC_CN AS ETC_CN /* 기타내용 */ , AA.LINK_PRCS_SE_CN AS x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM /* 접수의뢰경로구분명 */ , AA.LINK_INST_NM AS LINK_INST_NM /* 연계기관명 */ , AA.EML_SNDNG_YN AS EML_SNDNG_YN /* 이메일발송여부 */ FROM AYE100 AA SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssimListMapper.selectBbssoldList1 : 기타댓글상담 미답변*/ AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글 고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글 제목명 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ , CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분명 */ , DECODE(DD.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, NULL, '', 'Y') AS SRVY_RESULT_YN /* 설문조사여부 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT
, ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(A1.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT) FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원명 */ , ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS CONSTT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS REPLY_CNT /* 댓글수 */ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제상태대분류구분코드 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제원인대분류구분코드 , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD) AS GUBUN FROM AYE100 AA , SAC100 CC
, ( SELECT A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD FROM AYE195 A , AYE196 B WHERE A.INDEX_SN = B.INDEX_SN AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} GROUP BY A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) DD
, ( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD FROM AYE260 WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' GROUP BY BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) DD
, SAC100 EE WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND AA.END_YN = 'Y'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'Y' FROM AYE110 BB WHERE AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' )
AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글유형구분코드 */
AND CC.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 위기유형구분코드 */ AND CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) = AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD AND DD.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO (+) = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND DD.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD (+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND EE.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ AND EE.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD

AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */

AND CASE WHEN LENGTH(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) < 20 THEN AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT ELSE C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) END LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%'

AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD IS NULL /* 문제상태미등록 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
ORDER BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

, ( SELECT A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD FROM AYE195 A , AYE196 B WHERE A.INDEX_SN = B.INDEX_SN AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} GROUP BY A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) DD
, ( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD FROM AYE260 WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' GROUP BY BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) DD

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssimListMapper.selectBbssimDetailEum : 상세게시판 */ CNCT_PAGE_SN AS CNCT_PAGE_SN , REPLACE(REPLACE(QESITM_ANS_CN, '||', '|'), '|', '
') AS QESITM_ANS_CN FROM AYE210 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CNCT_PAGE_SN , CNCT_NTABRD_QESTN_SN

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssimListMapper.selectEumMailDetail : 발송할 메일 정보 조회(이음-e 마지막 댓글 + 이음-e 정보) */ SELECT ROWNUM , TT1.* FROM ( SELECT T1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , T1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ , T2.CMNT_ESNTAL_NO AS CMNT_ESNTAL_NO /* 댓글고유번호 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS BOARD_WRTR_NM /* 게시글 작성자명 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS WRTR_EMAIL /* 작성자 이메일 */ , T1.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD /* 이음게시판카테고리구분코드 */ , T1.SESN_MNG_NO AS SESN_MNG_NO /* 회기관리번호 */ , T1.EML_SNDNG_CYCL_DAYCNT AS EML_SNDNG_CYCL_DAYCNT /* 이메일발송주기일수 */ , T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_NM /* 이음게시판카테고리명 */ , (SELECT CASE T1.SESN_MNG_NO WHEN 1 THEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 WHEN 2 THEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 WHEN 3 THEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3 WHEN 4 THEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4 ELSE ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 END FROM SAC100 WHERE 1=1 AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T1.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD ) AS CURR_SESN_NM /* 현재 회기 제목 */ , (SELECT CASE T1.SESN_MNG_NO WHEN 1 THEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 WHEN 2 THEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3 WHEN 3 THEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4 WHEN 4 THEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 ELSE '-' END FROM SAC100 WHERE 1=1 AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T1.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD ) AS NEXT_SESN_NM /* 다음 회기 제목 */ , NVL(T2.CMNT_CN, '내용을 입력하세요.') AS CMNT_CN /* 댓글내용 */ , T2.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /* (댓글)최초등록일시 */ FROM AYE100 T1 /* 사이버상담게시글 */ , AYE110 T2 /* 사이버상담댓글 */ , ( SELECT * FROM SAC100 WHERE 1=1 AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) T3 /* 공통코드 : 이음게시판카테고리구분코드 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND T1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND T2.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO(+) = T1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND T2.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD(+) = T1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND ( T1.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR T1.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND ( T2.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR T2.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T1.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD ORDER BY T2.LAST_MDFCN_DT DESC, T2.FRST_REG_DT DESC ) TT1 WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: /* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssimListMapper.updateBbssim : 기타 댓글상담 상세내역 UPDATE * 2023.05.03 추가 - Jeong.Won.Je */ UPDATE AYE100 SET SXDC_SE_CD = #{SXDC_SE_CD} /* 성별구분코드 */ , ACBG_SE_CD = #{ACBG_SE_CD} /* 학력구분코드 */ , GRADE_SE_CD = #{GRADE_SE_CD} /* 학년구분코드 */ , GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD = #{GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD} /* 졸업상태구분코드 */ , REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD = #{REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD} /* 실제상담자구분코드 */ , REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN = #{REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN} /* 실제상담자기타내용 */ , YNGBGS_SE_NO = #{YNGBGS_SE_NO} /* 청소년구분번호 */ , PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류구분코드 */ , PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD} /* 문제상태중분류구분코드 */ , PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태소분류구분코드 */ , PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류구분코드 */ , PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인소분류구분코드 */ , ETC_CN = #{ETC_CN} /* 기타내용 */ , LINK_PRCS_SE_CN = #{LINK_PRCS_SE_CN} /* 연계처리구분내용 */ , RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = #{RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD} /* 접수의뢰경로구분코드 */ , LINK_INST_NM = #{LINK_INST_NM} /* 연계기관명 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시판유형구분코드 */
